comparator.finding: Diff is restricted to wait_notification. Callable invocation and truth conversion occur outside condition; selected item is removed only using is while condition held; missing selection restarts; ordered identity comparison before wait closes append/notify-during-evaluation lost-wake race.
comparator.limits: Arbitrary mutation/reentrant side effects, fairness and invocation count need not preserve baseline semantics. Queue-change restarts can exceed timeout under churn. Callback remains unbounded within its own call. No production or whole-call bound claim. Stale-identity and lost-wake constructions are not present in these four prospective cells.

driver_causal_sequence.finding: Initial notice is queued, request starts, actual request deadline plus wait frame and one condition waiter are sampled, peer receipt is obtained, then notification callback starts before request deadline and owner opens response gate. Final driver prospectively requires actual peer response wire_emitted and journal received ID1 before that same internal request deadline; otherwise it records invalid-exposure error and collector stops later cells. Active rows reads ignore only unfinished newline fragments; saved final checker rejects missing final newline. Held checkpoint nominally250ms after predicate entry; owner releases nominally400ms. Separate finish gate occurs after callers retire; reader joins before client.close; driver then closes FD handles separately.
driver_causal_sequence.baseline_end: After owner release, response publication versus request lock reacquisition may yield exact late return or TimeoutError. Neither should be assumed prospectively. Notification match precedence permits exact notification return after its deadline in both arms.
driver_causal_sequence.driver_errors: Driver treats caller exceptions as outcomes, not driver failures. Saved checker must reject unintended healthy/candidate request exceptions, while accepting the explicitly allowed baseline-held TimeoutError. Driver exit0 alone does not prove causal result.
